unique_content_purpose: Help senior candidates distinguish Japan's monthly Basic and quarterly Detailed Labour Force Survey tabulations and account for seasonal-adjustment and classification changes when interpreting historical evidence.
duplication_and_cannibalisation_assessme: The existing executive job-search resource is jurisdiction-neutral. This draft focuses on the Japanese Labour Force Survey's tabulation schedule, e-Stat historical-data access, 2026 seasonal-adjustment revision and occupation-related classification change. Existing Japan market coverage and full page-level overlap remain to be reviewed.
